summary.lv: Aerones Engineering meklē vecāko NetSuite administratoru, kurš/-a atbalstīs NetSuite ERP ieviešanu, sadarbojoties ar NetSuite partneri un iekšējām biznesa komandām visā projekta dzīvesciklā.
summary.en: Aerones Engineering seeks a Senior NetSuite Admin to support the end-to-end NetSuite ERP implementation, working closely with the NetSuite partner and in-house teams on requirements, configuration, and go-live.
